method: Expanding-window chronological walk-forward with per-fold train-only scaling, 24-window purge/embargo gaps, absolute and persistence-residual PATRON candidates, and paired day-block bootstrap inference.

decision.note: A recommendation is not deployment. The current production checkpoint was not copied or modified; any promotion requires separate human approval.

limitations: One local BTCUSDT M15 dataset; no live broker sample.
Four folds, one seed; bootstrap intervals account for sampling but not model-seed variance.
No fees, funding, slippage, fills or execution simulation.
The deployed checkpoint reference is not leakage-safe across folds and is excluded from promotion.
Regime labels are causal but thresholds were fixed in the protocol; low-sample slices are descriptive only.
